name: b2bsearch-mcp
display_name: b2bsearch: B2B contacts and account signals
description: New hires, company email format, lookalike companies, decision makers, emails by LinkedIn URL and people search, pay per result on Apify.
long_description: Six task-named tools over the b2bsearch Actors on Apify: find_new_hires, company_email_format, find_lookalike_companies, find_decision_makers, find_email_by_linkedin_url, search_people. Every call takes a spend cap; misses are free rows. You bring your own Apify token.

tools.name: find_new_hires
tools.description: Who recently joined the given companies, with the employer they came from

tools.name: company_email_format
tools.description: A company's work email convention from addresses on record

tools.name: find_lookalike_companies
tools.description: Companies similar to example companies, with explicit match criteria

tools.name: find_decision_makers
tools.description: Founders, C-level, VPs and directors at company domains

tools.name: find_email_by_linkedin_url
tools.description: The email on record for LinkedIn profile URLs

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: People by title, seniority, country and employer; free count and market modes

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: From Apify Console → Settings → Integrations. Runs are billed to this account, pay per result.
